aiDescription: Replaces static icons for various colony items with animated versions. Covers items such as the Corrupted Nanoforge, Synchrotron Core, and Plasma Dynamo. Some items like the Autonomous Mantle Bore are still marked as work in progress.

gallery.aiCaption: A pixel art sprite of a wooden chair with glowing red and blue animated elements.
A Starsector inventory screen showing various animated colony item sprites in the cargo hold.
A Patreon button with the Patreon logo and text.
